newsitem.title: USA: Georgia House approves $11.7 billion budget.
newsitem.headline: Georgia House approves $11.7 billion budget.

text.p: The Georgia House of Representatives approved an $11.7 billion budget Monday by a vote of 154-24, the clerk's office said.
The House version gives teachers a six percent raise, but limits raises for administrative education workers to four percent. Gov. Zell Miller had sought six percent raises across the board.
The House rejected Miller's proposal to spend $59 million to cut student-teacher rations, insteady allocating most of tht money for high school and vocational lab programs the governor wanted to cut.

The House also rejected Miller's $6.2 million proposal to expand eligibility for the HOPE scholarship program, and restored $4.2 million that Miller proposed cutting from local health and dental programs.
